### Conversational AI

How It Works

Easily implement conversational AI that runs locally on device to perform visual scene analysis, product inspection, or provide timely information in the field for complex setup/repair. Leverage Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to quickly extent model’s expertise.

Key Benefits

- Eliminates operational stoppages caused by complex interfaces and language barriers on the factory floor
- Unifies manufacturing lines across cross-border locations with intuitive human-machine interaction
- Meets strict data security requirements — no cloud roundtrips, all inference on-device

## Why Customers Choose SiMa.ai for Industrial Systems

Purpose-built silicon and software for critical industrial applications — from factory floors to autonomous mobile robots.

### Predictive Maintenance

AI models on-device analyze sensor data — vibration, temperature, pressure — to detect early signs of wear or failure before they cause downtime.

### Real-Time Quality Inspection

Cameras combined with AI inspect products for defects in real time at line speed — increasing product quality and reducing scrap rates.

### Robotics and Cobots

Physical AI powers real-time decision-making in robots, enabling adaptation to changing environments and safe human collaboration.

### Inventory and Supply Chain AI

AI-enabled sensors and cameras track materials and parts, providing instant feedback on inventory levels to minimize shortages or overstocking.

### Best-in-Class Performance per Watt

Industry-leading frames-per-second performance with multimodal compute at the edge — enabling 10x improvement over incumbent solutions.
